instruction_summary: Living update (study 001): test the TvL model's four pre-declared signatures P1-P4 against the newest open data in tennis, chess, baseball, movies, science, poker (+MusicLab literature branch), using independent ex-ante skill proxies and the faithful engine as model-side reference.

steps.description: G1 integrity: sha256 of 126 staged files + coverage sanity
G2 engine reference: 1000 baseline runs + pL={20,50,80} ladder with faithful reimpl engine
B1 tennis: P2 (point-share vs titles) + leakage control + G3 split-half
B2 chess: top-100 consecutive-January persistence anchor; S2 degenerate
B3 baseball: OPS persistence (ladder), team series, Statcast P2, salary concentration, G3
B4 movies: IMDb rating-vs-votes P2 + within-decile validity + concentration
B5 science: OpenAlex citation concentration (staged 2015 + declared in-run 2010/2019 pulls)
B6 poker: champions parsed row-by-row; power statement; descriptive bracelet row
B7 MusicLab: else-branch (raw data human-gated) literature row
Block C: signatures assembly, S4 ordering, exceedance probabilities, 3 figures, embargo-lifted comparison
Block D: findings.md, gates.json, report.md, result_card.json

key_results.G2: PASS vs staged QA integrity bands
key_results.P1_shape: present in 4/4 concentration domains (consistent with any multiplicative mechanism)
key_results.P2_tennis_verdict: decoupling signature absent (talent-dominated corner); model-baseline exceedance 1.3% winner / 0% top-10-median
key_results.P3_verdict: partial ordering: persistence holds, decoupling does not order with it

comparison_to_original.note: fat tail present in reality; model's own share 0.771 < printed 0.80
real top-success sits far above model baseline -> decoupling absent

deviations: shared-data/tvl-engine/ not separately staged; used the faithful replication engine reimpl/tvl.py (fidelity established in replication).
shared-data/qa-distcheck/distcheck_results.json not staged; G2 integrity bands taken from the centers quoted verbatim in spec section 1.
recency-research.md not staged; its numeric pass/fail rules are quoted inline in spec section 4 and applied from there.
Seeds 1..1000 realized as independent batched replicates under fixed master seeds (batched engine seeds the RNG stream, not per-replicate).
Tennis top-100 persistence 0.678 (2011-2025) vs preview 0.645 (last-ranking-date handling); split-half reliability still clears the validity rule.
MusicLab raw data human-gated -> honest-exclusion literature branch (as the spec's ELSE path specifies).
Biondo-Pluchino SSRN 6572147 (2026) is concurrent and not yet read (metadata-verified; bot-blocked) -- a human should read it before external publication.

[003 audit-conformance 001-2] Truncation deviation declared: Spec 5 Block A G2 says 'no truncation' but the G2 run used truncate_talent=True, chosen for construct-consistency with the staged QA distcheck anchor bands (computed with truncation ON); truncation clips ~3e-5 of talent draws, numerically immaterial to every G2 band/reference; spec-text conflict named, not silently followed.
